record.content: In the USGS Topo Map Vector Data product 25034 Lassen Peak CA, NPS-originated Bumpass Hell Trail feature d0d63ec3-c99c-41e0-a353-50ac64f4fff8 runs from (-121.5140219, 40.4661208) to (-121.5027609, 40.4571800) with lengthmiles 1.26580720. Feature bb47380f-f9c1-43dc-b734-cdc1435cf00b continues from that exact endpoint to (-121.5023271, 40.4573718) with lengthmiles 0.02984205, where it shares an endpoint with a Bumpass Hell Boardwalk feature and a separate Bumpass Hell Trail feature continuing east. The trail features identify National Park Service as source originator and NPS Trails 11/2019 as their source-data description; the dataset warns that temporal changes may have occurred.
